svg.text: 拿到 ΔT 之后，怎么给这一次抖动定罪

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: ΔT(TSC) 只有一个数，但它的构成有四种；用相邻边界的计数器差分把它们区分开

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 这一次 ΔT(TSC) 变大

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: = 用户态执行 + 内核态(fault/IRQ/syscall) + 被切走时间 + halt/虚拟化时间

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 观测：Δinstructions 明显增大

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: → 路径变长：多干了活

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 数据相关冷分支、异常分支、fault 处理指令

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 观测：inst 正常，cycles:u 增大 + LLC-miss 高

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: → 微架构停顿：在等硬件

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 内存/缓存、分支预测失败、NUMA 远端访问

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 观测：cycles:u 不动，内核时间变长，minflt +1

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: → 内核介入

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: minor/major page fault、系统调用、内核线程

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 观测：TSC 照走，ref-cycles 停走（出现缺口）

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: → off-core：核被拿走了

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 被抢占、vCPU 被 host deschedule、halt 进 C-state、SMI

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 观测：core-cycles / ref-cycles 比例下降

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: → 降频

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: AVX-512 license、温度/功耗墙、云上频率被限

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif

svg.text: 注意计数器是单调累计的：必须每个边界都读、相邻请求差分复用，等触发了才第一次读，拿到的会是横跨几万次请求的区间
